entities.summary: Premchand Roychand (1832–1906) was an Indian Śvetāmbara Jain businessman known as the "Cotton King" and "Bullion King" from Bombay. He is most well-known for the establishment of Bombay Stock Exchange and for his donation in the construction of the Rajabai Clock Tower.
